intent: A side panel hosting the comment threads for a page: an Open / Resolved / All filter, thread previews, and the selected thread (pass a kit CommentThread as children) with Resolve. Built on kit Drawer and SegmentedControl; inline renders it in place, and inline="auto" docks it beside the page from --grid-breakpoint-lg.
useWhen: a page (invoice, document) has several comment threads
people filter open and resolved threads and open one
a header needs a Comments button with the open count
a page docks its threads beside the content on wide screens (inline="auto")
doNotUseWhen: one conversation on its own — CommentThread

threads.note: { id, title, preview, count, resolved?, updatedAt, context? }[]. context names the record (e.g. "INV-1842 · Northwind") and leads the open thread's meta line: "INV-1842 · 3 comments · Open". Use one date format for updatedAt, e.g. "Nov 20, 10:26".

onSelect.note: (id | null) => void; null goes back to the list.

children.note: The selected thread, usually a CommentThread without a title.

composer.note: Shown under the list, e.g. a page-level CommentThread.

inline.note: true renders the panel in place. "auto" docks it beside the page from --grid-breakpoint-lg while open (the trigger comes back when it closes) and uses the Drawer below that.

requirements: the trigger is a kit Button described by the open count Badge

the panel is the kit Drawer dialog (focus trap, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger); inline or docked it is a complementary region labelled by label, and closing a docked auto panel returns focus to the trigger
the filter is a kit SegmentedControl radio group
threads are buttons; resolved threads say so to screen readers; the open thread says "INV-1842 · 3 comments · Open" in words
All threads (ghost) returns focus to the thread that was opened; below --grid-breakpoint-sm it reads "Threads"
below --grid-breakpoint-sm Close, All threads and Resolve grow to md (36) for touch
list and thread crossfade on opacity, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local CommentsDrawer or ThreadList
Do not re-implement the thread: pass a CommentThread as children
Do not use Tabs for the Open / Resolved / All filter
snippet:
<CommentsPanel threads={threads} open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} selectedId={selected} onSelect={setSelected} onResolve={resolve}>
  <CommentThread comments={comments} value={draft} onValueChange={setDraft} onSubmit={post} />
</CommentsPanel>
